definitions.explanation: The historical background or pedigree of a place, family, or thing, especially when it is long, distinguished, or noteworthy. Most commonly encountered in the compound 由緒ある (having a distinguished history).

examples.japanese: {由緒|ゆいしょ}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れた→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: I visited a shrine with a distinguished history.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{由緒|ゆいしょ}⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧で、⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: This inn is a building with a distinguished pedigree, having been in operation since the Edo period.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{由緒|ゆいしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{武将|ぶしょう}→武将：13222_bushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{所有|しょゆう}→所有：12752_shoyuu⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{伝|つた}えられている→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: This sword has a notable history, and it is said to have once been owned by a famous military commander.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used in the set expressions {由緒|ゆいしょ}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (having a distinguished history) and {由緒|ゆいしょ}⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧ (of distinguished/legitimate lineage). Typically describes temples, shrines, families, inns, and historical objects.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {由緒|ゆいしょ}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (having a distinguished history)
- {由緒|ゆいしょ}⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧ (of impeccable lineage, prestigious)
- {由緒|ゆいしょ}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{寺院|じいん}→寺院：00122_jiin⟧ (temple with a distinguished history)
- {由緒|ゆいしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誇|ほこ}る→誇る：14180_hokoru⟧ (boast a distinguished history)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧: history (general, broader meaning)
- ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧: tradition (customs passed down, not specifically lineage)
- ⟦{来歴|らいれき}→来歴：15072_raireki⟧: history, provenance (the story of how something came to be)
